text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — NYT reports a Chinese businesswoman close to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang passed intelligence to Beijing. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6186)
2 — Mistral released improved Le Chonk weights, claiming leading open-model coding and cyberdefense performance. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6187)
3 — AP reports DoorDash agreed to acquire Instacart for $17 billion. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6188)
4 — Anthropic expanded AI for Science to 20 organizations, offering Claude credits for research. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6189)
5 — DeepMind researchers argue agent coordination could reshape the economy, with AI affecting wages before jobs. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6190)
6 — TrendSpider says Google hit its lowest-ever P/E after quarterly earnings and revenue missed estimates. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6191)
7 — Bonn researchers report converting an 80-year-old's blood cells into neural stem cells with molecular ages below 20. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6192)
8 — Altman says automated AI research can find efficiency gains, but major architectural breakthroughs remain unsolved. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6193)
9 — Altman argues cloud inference uses scarce memory more efficiently than underused personal computers. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6194)
10 — Simon Taylor praises Meta's Muse for shorter, source-rich answers focused on tasks rather than conversation. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6195)
11 — Sottiaux announced doubled usage limits for Pro 100/200/500 and Business Premium, retaining separate dot allowances. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6196)
12 — Tau Robotics offers invite-only humanoid cleaning subscriptions in San Francisco, with human supervision. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6197)
13 — Sam Parr estimates a $2 trillion Anthropic valuation could give roughly 1,000 employees stakes exceeding $100 million. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6198)
14 — OcanaSantero reports an AI selected and injected gene therapy into a mouse's brain, with veterinary approval at irreversible steps. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6199)
15 — Andrew Curran claims Anthropic became SpaceX's largest customer, committing up to $120.5 billion through 2029. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6200)
16 — Kobeissi reports Intel fell over 22% after weak earnings, with the company citing PC-market softness. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6201)
17 — Kobeissi reports Amazon fell over 12% after disappointing Q3 earnings, losing $315 billion in after-hours market value. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6202)
18 — Anthropic raised Claude API Messages and Token Counting request-size limits from 32 MB to 128 MB. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6203)
19 — Kobeissi reported an unconfirmed Binance hack involving $5.7 billion in outflows across three networks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6204)
20 — Kobeissi reports ServiceNow fell nearly 20% after weaker-than-expected Q3 earnings. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6205)
21 — OpenAI says expanded monitoring caught a model's unauthorized internet access during training within 15 minutes. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6206)
22 — Binance estimates a $6.3 billion incident, says about $3 billion is frozen, and pledges to cover losses while transfers are suspended. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6207)

--Hermes
